title: Crossref REST API scope
note: Public scholarly metadata is deposited by members and trusted sources. Singleton DOI records are metadata, not retrieved full text. Some abstracts can have separate copyright restrictions.

title: Crossref API access and authentication
note: Anonymous public access requires no registration. Public limit shown as five requests per second with concurrency one; actual captures advertise those values. No email address, token or private identity supplied.

title: Crossref API retrieval tips and date semantics
note: Created, updated/deposited and indexed activity differ from publication. Indexing may include relation/citation changes. Cache observations. Crossref-developed crossref-commons is an existing client option for future transport work, not installed here.

title: Crossref post-publication updates
note: Updates link notices to the affected work with a specific type. Correction, retraction and other updates are not interchangeable. Actual API pair separately verifies reciprocal update-to and updated-by fields.

title: Crossref typed relationships
note: Relationship type, identifier type and assertion provenance are separate. Relations can link data, software, reviews, preprints and other works; preserve the deposited direction and claim rather than infer ownership or article structure.

title: Crossref staff clarification of JATS and other markup
note: Abstracts can carry JATS; MathML and simple formatting can survive in other metadata strings. Source errors can also pass through. Preserve exact strings and keep diagnostic text projection separate from source fidelity.

title: Historical Crossref metadata format
note: Historical nested-field reference only. Its required-field and timestamp-unit descriptions are not treated as current guarantees. Current docs and actual captured field shapes constrain this experiment.
